d: Karl-Anthony Towns continues his DOMINANT start to the season, finishing with 30 POINTS, 13 REBOUNDS, 3 STEALS and 4 THREE-POINTERS. KAT recorded his 16th consecutive double-double to open the season, joining Nikola Jokić (20), Giannis Antetokounmpo (19) and Domantas Sabonis (16) as the only players since the 1981-82 season to accomplish this incredible feat. The last player to achieve this before this historic group was Moses Malone, who also opened the 1981-82 season with 16 straight double-doubles.
